title: Lower bound near the upper endpoint
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f$ be a monotone, nonconstant Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. Suppose $0<p_c<1/2$, $0<\delta<1/2$, and the biased-minus probability polynomial of $f$ at $p_c$ equals $1/2$. Then $1-\sqrt{\delta/2}$ is at most the value of that polynomial at $1-\delta$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
